tbesh_html:
1) to be or become dark, grow dim, be darkened, be black, be hidden
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to be or grow dark
1a2) to have a dark colour
1a3) to grow dim
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to make dark, cause to be dark
1b2) to hide, conceal
1b3) to obscure, confuse (fig.)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken
strongs_1890.kjv_def: be black, be (make) dark, darken, cause darkness, be dim, hide.
